Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning use classifications for irrigation district conveyance and drainage facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to use classifications for irrigation districtconveyance and drainage facilities; and adding a new section to chapter90.48 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall at the request of the United States bureau ofreclamation and federal reclamation project irrigation districtscooperatively conduct a use attainability analysis of water bodieslocated within the boundaries of the federal reclamation project. Thedepartment shall adopt rules designating uses for water bodies withinthe federal reclamation project that reflect the intended use ofconstructed storage and conveyance facilities and other water transportsystems for authorized project purposes and the unique sitespecificcharacteristics of the arid and semiarid regions of the state ofWashington where federal reclamation projects are located. The rulesshall be consistent with authorized project purposes and shall not p. 1 HB 2982impair authorized project contracts or interfere with the construction,operation, or maintenance of project facilities.
